data.name: Arunkumar
data.long_meaning: The name Arunkumar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘arun’ which means ‘red’ or ‘dawn’, and ‘kumar’ which means ‘younger brother of Lord Krishna’. This name signifies the one who is as radiant as the sun at dawn. It is also the name of Lord Arun, the god of rain in Hindu mythology.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the radiant and powerful energy of the sun and the divine grace of Lord Krishna.

In India, it is believed that the Dawn God Arun brings the blessings of rain and prosperity, thus associating the name with good fortune and prosperity.

It also highlights the strong brotherly bond between Arunkumar (indicating Lord Krishna) and Krishna, emphasizing the importance of brotherhood and devotion towards deities.
